policy.older_scope_rule: Every older use is bound to its own declared purpose and cohort and is excluded from the primary denominator.
policy.availability_rule: Future or unavailable rows remain ineligible under the existing typed clocks and source-quality gates.

conventions.time_unit: UTC nanoseconds as exact int64-compatible integers
conventions.fold_interval: decision and evaluation intervals are half-open where the current fold APIs specify a range
conventions.primary_row_rule: Every retained training, calibration, or evaluation Sample/TemporalSampleV1 decision_at must be at or after primary_start_ns_utc.
conventions.primary_clock_rule: A primary fold must also have fit_at, evaluation_start, and any training_start at or after primary_start_ns_utc; its evaluation_end remains bounded by actual eligibility at the frozen cut rather than a fixed calendar end.
conventions.raw_past_rule: A pre-period raw_past dependency is not admitted to the primary model. It may be retained only under diagnostic, jumbo_optional, or ohlc_optional purpose with its own denominator and causal disclosure. A primary boundary row with no pre-period dependency may pass the period check, subject to maturity, OOF, embargo, source, and availability gates.
conventions.source_quality_rule: Passing the period check never upgrades missing, incomplete, unpaired, unavailable, or purpose-ineligible source evidence.
conventions.historical_e0_rule: The existing E0_exact 2022-2025 completeness harness remains a separate historical harness; it is not the wider primary 2020+ admission policy.

fixture_artifact_rule.cohort_artifact: Each cohort fixture includes a literal certification payload. A test harness may publish that payload through ArtifactStore.put_json and fill ArtifactRef from the returned immutable reference; the certification payload itself is part of this contract.
fixture_artifact_rule.temporal_dependency_artifact: Temporal dependency fixtures include the literal dependency identity and clocks. The harness must publish the exact TemporalDependencyEvidenceV1 bytes before calling validate_dependency_bytes; the period disposition is independent of that publication step.

cases.purpose: Reject a complete-looking cohort whose first observation is one nanosecond before the inclusive primary boundary.

expected.artifact_scope_effect: The exact artifact certification must still be checked; it cannot override the period failure.
expected.permitted_legacy_disposition: Retain immutable audit evidence under diagnostic or an explicitly declared optional scope with next_action if that scope is ineligible.

cases.purpose: Prove that the inclusive boundary itself passes the period gate without asserting full source eligibility.

expected.boundary_assertion: observation_start equal to primary_start_ns_utc is accepted; a strict greater-than comparison is forbidden.

cases.purpose: Retain observed field-preservation evidence while preventing a row prefix with no range from certifying a primary cohort.

cohort_evidence.reason: field and schema preservation observed on a bounded row prefix

expected.required_message: primary cohort evidence requires concrete observation bounds and a complete operation-specific window
expected.next_action: capture and certify a complete 2020-onward operation-specific window with actual availability and source identity
expected.legacy_note: CohortEvidence.__post_init__ already prevents eligible state for row_prefix; the new primary admission check must also prevent an observed row_prefix from being promoted later.

cases.purpose: Close period bypasses at fold compilation, direct legacy Fold construction, model preflight, calibration, and fitted measurement admission.

diagnostic_variant.raw_past_rule: The boundary row may be retained as a causal diagnostic only when raw_past.end and raw_past.known_at are no later than decision_at; it cannot be reused by a primary model fold.

expected.required_message: primary fold population contains a pre-period decision row or a disallowed pre-period raw_past dependency

compilation.validate_fold_population: recheck the complete retained population and reject even when a caller supplies a manually constructed Fold
compilation.validate_temporal_fold_population: recheck the complete retained temporal population and reject even when a caller supplies a manually constructed TemporalFoldV1

direct_fold_bypass.Fold_constructor: May remain a structural declaration for legacy compatibility, but it is not primary admission evidence.
direct_fold_bypass.preflight_training: must reject the direct declaration after inspecting every supplied BinaryExample sample under scope=primary_model
direct_fold_bypass.fit_sigmoid_calibration: must inherit the preflight rejection before reading base predictions
direct_fold_bypass.admit_measurement_fit: must reject a primary retained temporal population containing either disallowed row

expected.exact_boundary_without_lookback: A 2020-01-01 decision row with no pre-period raw_past dependency may pass the period check; maturity, OOF, embargo, source, and actual availability still apply.

cases.purpose: Reject a protocol that freezes a pre-period evaluation date and admit the corrected boundary-only date list only after all other registration gates.

literal.frozen_cut_rule: The corrected variant has no hard-coded primary end date beyond its registered endpoint; each date must still have actual eligible observations at the frozen cut.

next_gates: frozen model IDs before future confirmation starts

expected.registration_clock_note: Registration may occur before the first2020 observation; the observed primary population lower bound does not forbid earlier protocol registration.

cases.purpose: Keep a 2022 period pass separate from an ES quote-source failure for a quote-dependent operation.

literal.reason: no ES MBP rows for the selected hour; standalone ES trades are present but do not certify quote-dependent operations
literal.next_action: capture or certify the missing ES MBP partition and actual receipt/clock assumptions

expected.required_message: missing ES MBP partition for the selected quote-dependent cohort
expected.standalone_trade_disposition: independently assessed; may not inherit quote eligibility
expected.measurement_fit_effect: admit_measurement_fit must reject if the actual retained fold/evidence closure depends on this missing source; it must not report pre_period_observation.

cases.purpose: Show that a 2020+ date can pass the period gate while execution terms, verified venue boundaries, and complete parent-universe lineage remain blocking dependencies.

term_check.raw_flow: may pass because raw identity does not require valuation terms

universe_check.primary_e0: fail because acquired_outright_cohort is not a complete parent universe for the exact E0 contract
universe_check.low_level_selection: must fail with missing definition or missing previous-session volume when the declared incomplete fixture is evaluated

cross_case_invariants: Only PERIOD-02 and the period sub-check of PERIOD-06 and PERIOD-07 pass the lower-bound test; a period pass never implies source or execution eligibility.
No case may place a pre-2020 row in a primary training, calibration, or evaluation denominator.
A manually constructed legacy Fold or Protocol cannot serve as primary evidence without an explicit policy/scope admission check and a retained policy hash.
Missing ES 2022 MBP remains a source-quality/availability failure and is never renamed as a period failure.
Pre-2020 storage partitions remain retainable for audit and explicit optional/diagnostic work; the period gate belongs at purpose-specific cohort, fold, model, measurement, and evaluation admission.
The primary end is resolved from actual eligible observations at the frozen evaluation cut; no fixture may replace it with an arbitrary fixed calendar end.

pre_freeze_root_dispositions.reason: Both original/corrected PERIOD05 future protocols must register strictly before the first evaluation observation. B-1 replaces B only for registered_at so the period fixture reaches the intended independent boundary. No implementation was executed.

Primary sample/observation boundary does not globally reject older static definitions/calendar publication metadata. Optional older Jumbo/OHLC context or comparisons retain separate purpose/cohort provenance; arbitrary preperiod raw_past remains ineligible for primary use.

Future confirmation protocols may declare future endpoints before observations exist. Actual source availability is checked at data admission/model reads/result completion; a planned future endpoint is not a completed eligible observation.
